zotero.abstractNote: This paper introduces openretina, an open-source modeling platform designed to unify fragmented retinal research data across different species and experimental conditions. Despite the abundance of retinal datasets, the lack of standardized tools hinders the development of generalizable models. To this end, we present openretina, a modular Python package built on PyTorch that provides a standardised framework for training, evaluating, and sharing retinal models. By abstracting data loading and model architecture, openretina enables researchers to easily benchmark models across diverse datasets, facilitating collaborative efforts in computational neuroscience.
